h: Messi wins Princess of Asturias Award days before the Ballon d'Or ceremony
p: Lionel Messi has reportedly won the Princess of Asturias Award, and Barcelona has congratulated him. The honour comes just days before the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London.
more: Barcelona publicly reacted to the news.
The Ballon d'Or ceremony takes place in London this week.
